semantics: gradient_norm is the return of clip_grad_norm_, i.e. pre-clip global norm

adjudication.optimizer: AdamW (config q12 optimizer.type=adamw, trainer enforces AdamW-only)
adjudication.verdict: DEMOTED: Adam-family updates are invariant to constant gradient rescaling (m and sqrt(v) cancel), so clip-rate 1.0 is NOT a 150x step attenuation; residual effect is per-step variable rescaling (norm 14-27, ~2x) which mildly damps high-norm steps relative to low-norm ones
adjudication.historical_context: R1 epochs 1-12 clip_rate 1.000 (median norm 19.3-19.9), q8_fast_anneal likewise (17.7-27.0) - property of the whole recipe family, not Q12
adjudication.action: not an arm; keep as recipe documentation; competitor trains without clipping (their clip code commented out)
